version_history.v1.0 (2026-06-02 AM): initial release — hedging_formal = relational ∪ propositional (Ulinski & Hirschberg 2019)
version_history.v2.0 (2026-06-02 PM): per user revision: hedging_formal reduced to RELATIONAL subset only. Propositional terms (quantifiers/intensifiers like 'a bit', 'approximately', 'really') dropped from the active lexicon — they were too noisy in reasoning traces.

notes: Freeze before computing features. Do not tune to results (p-hacking guard). Matching is case-insensitive, word-boundary aware (e.g. does not match 'so' inside 'also'), and phrase-aware for multi-word entries. Active hedging lexicon in v2.0 = hedging_formal.relational ∪ hedging_reasoning.terms (76 terms total).

hedging_formal.source: Ulinski & Hirschberg (2019), Crowdsourced Hedge Term Disambiguation (ACL Anthology W19-4001), Table 1 — RELATIONAL subset only (the speaker-stance hedges). Propositional subset (quantifiers/intensifiers) dropped in v2.0 — see version_history.

hedging_formal_propositional_DROPPED_v2.note: Preserved for audit/replication; NOT used by the v2.0 active lexicon. Re-enable by merging back into hedging_formal.relational and re-computing features.

hedging_reasoning.source: Our frozen addition: hedging / self-correction / backtracking markers common in reasoning-model traces. Declared as our own extension (not from a published list).

connectors_logical.source: Our frozen addition: causal / deductive / assertion connectors. EXPLORATORY and NEUTRAL — do NOT assume these indicate certainty; treated as a structural trace property only.
